+__device__ uint64_t mixBits(uint64_t value) {
+    value += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, int ray, int component) {
+    const uint64_t bits = mixBits(42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL) ^
+                                  (static_cast<uint64_t>(ray) << 16) ^
+                                  static_cast<uint64_t>(component));
+    return static_cast<val_t>((bits >> 40) + 0.5) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDevice(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                             uint64_t pairIndex, int ray,
+                                             int componentOffset) {
+    val_t u = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset);
+    val_t v = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset + 1);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDevice(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersectDevice(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                             const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 pvec = direction.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const val_t invDet = ONE / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = origin - triangle.a;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < ZERO || u > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = direction.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < ZERO || u + v > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool isRayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                    const Triangle* triangles,
+                                    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                    const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                    uint32_t nodeCount, uint32_t srcTriangle,
+                                    uint32_t dstTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 ray = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = ray.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 direction = ray / rayLength;
+
+    // Nodes are stored in depth-first order.  subtreeEnd makes traversal
+    // stackless: a rejected box skips its complete subtree.
+    uint32_t nodeIndex = 0;
+    while (nodeIndex < nodeCount) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!rayIntersectsBoxDevice(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = node.subtreeEnd;
+            continue;
+        }
+        for (uint32_t ref = 0; ref < node.triangleCount; ++ref) {
+            const uint32_t triangleIndex = triangleRefs[node.triangleOffset + ref];
+            if (triangleIndex == srcTriangle || triangleIndex == dstTriangle) continue;
+            const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersectDevice(
+                from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+        }
+        ++nodeIndex;
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                        size_t pairCount) {
+    const size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const val_t distance = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                         uint32_t nodeCount, val_t* kij,
+                                         size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                         size_t pairCount) {
+    constexpr unsigned RAY_GROUP_SIZE = NUM_RAYS;
+    const size_t linearThread = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t pair = linearThread / RAY_GROUP_SIZE;
+    const unsigned ray = static_cast<unsigned>(linearThread % RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    val_t sample = ZERO;
+
+    if (i != j && triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) <= 0.99f) {
+        const uint64_t globalPair = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j;
+        const Vec3 pointI = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleI, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 0);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleJ, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 2);
+        if (!isRayBlockedDevice(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleRefs,
+                                nodeCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                                static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) {
+            const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+            const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared >= EPSILON) {
+                const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+                const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    direction.dot(triangleI.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    (-direction).dot(triangleJ.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                    sample = (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    const unsigned laneInWarp = threadIdx.x & 31U;
+    const unsigned groupBase = laneInWarp & ~15U;
+    const unsigned mask = 0x0000ffffU << groupBase;
+    for (unsigned offset = RAY_GROUP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        sample += __shfl_down_sync(mask, sample, offset, RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    }
+    if (ray == 0) kij[pair] = sample * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                const val_t* areas, val_t* radiosity,
+                                size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const size_t matrixRow = localI * numTriangles;
+
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixRow + j];
+        if (timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay)) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[matrixRow + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const val_t previous = radiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) *
+                                         numTriangles + j];
+        if (previous <= ZERO) continue;
+        sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * previous;
+    }
+
+    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+    radiosity[timestep * numTriangles + i] = reflectivity * sum + emission;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances,
+                                       size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                       size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t maximumCorrelation = ZERO;
+    size_t bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = 0; lag < numTimesteps; ++lag) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+            sum += radiosity[(t - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex] *
+                   radiosity[t * numTriangles + i];
+        }
+        if (sum > maximumCorrelation) {
+            maximumCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTimestep = lag;
+        }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON) atomicAdd(nonzero, 1ULL);
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergyKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t numTriangles,
+                                  size_t numTimesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                                  size_t localCount, unsigned long long* received) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(received, 1ULL);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-free representation used by CUDA kernels.  Leaf triangle references
+// retain the exact ordering of the host octree traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    uint32_t triangleOffset;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+    uint32_t subtreeEnd;
+};
+
+int flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                      std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleRefs) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = source.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleRefs.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleRefs.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleRefs);
+        }
+    }
+    nodes[static_cast<size_t>(nodeIndex)].subtreeEnd =
+        static_cast<uint32_t>(nodes.size());
+    return nodeIndex;
+}

+__device__ uint64_t mixBits(uint64_t value) {
+    value += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, int ray, int component) {
+    const uint64_t bits = mixBits(42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL) ^
+                                  (static_cast<uint64_t>(ray) << 16) ^
+                                  static_cast<uint64_t>(component));
+    return static_cast<val_t>((bits >> 40) + 0.5) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDevice(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                             uint64_t pairIndex, int ray,
+                                             int componentOffset) {
+    val_t u = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset);
+    val_t v = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset + 1);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDevice(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersectDevice(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                             const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 pvec = direction.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const val_t invDet = ONE / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = origin - triangle.a;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < ZERO || u > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = direction.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < ZERO || u + v > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool isRayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                    const Triangle* triangles,
+                                    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                    const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                    uint32_t nodeCount, uint32_t srcTriangle,
+                                    uint32_t dstTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 ray = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = ray.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 direction = ray / rayLength;
+
+    // Nodes are stored in depth-first order.  subtreeEnd makes traversal
+    // stackless: a rejected box skips its complete subtree.
+    uint32_t nodeIndex = 0;
+    while (nodeIndex < nodeCount) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!rayIntersectsBoxDevice(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = node.subtreeEnd;
+            continue;
+        }
+        for (uint32_t ref = 0; ref < node.triangleCount; ++ref) {
+            const uint32_t triangleIndex = triangleRefs[node.triangleOffset + ref];
+            if (triangleIndex == srcTriangle || triangleIndex == dstTriangle) continue;
+            const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersectDevice(
+                from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+        }
+        ++nodeIndex;
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                        size_t pairCount) {
+    const size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const val_t distance = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                         uint32_t nodeCount, val_t* kij,
+                                         size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                         size_t pairCount) {
+    constexpr unsigned RAY_GROUP_SIZE = NUM_RAYS;
+    const size_t linearThread = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t pair = linearThread / RAY_GROUP_SIZE;
+    const unsigned ray = static_cast<unsigned>(linearThread % RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    val_t sample = ZERO;
+
+    if (i != j && triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) <= 0.99f) {
+        const uint64_t globalPair = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j;
+        const Vec3 pointI = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleI, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 0);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleJ, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 2);
+        if (!isRayBlockedDevice(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleRefs,
+                                nodeCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                                static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) {
+            const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+            const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared >= EPSILON) {
+                const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+                const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    direction.dot(triangleI.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    (-direction).dot(triangleJ.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                    sample = (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    const unsigned laneInWarp = threadIdx.x & 31U;
+    const unsigned groupBase = laneInWarp & ~15U;
+    const unsigned mask = 0x0000ffffU << groupBase;
+    for (unsigned offset = RAY_GROUP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        sample += __shfl_down_sync(mask, sample, offset, RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    }
+    if (ray == 0) kij[pair] = sample * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                const val_t* areas, val_t* radiosity,
+                                size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const size_t matrixRow = localI * numTriangles;
+
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixRow + j];
+        if (timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay)) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[matrixRow + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const val_t previous = radiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) *
+                                         numTriangles + j];
+        if (previous <= ZERO) continue;
+        sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * previous;
+    }
+
+    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+    radiosity[timestep * numTriangles + i] = reflectivity * sum + emission;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances,
+                                       size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                       size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t maximumCorrelation = ZERO;
+    size_t bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = 0; lag < numTimesteps; ++lag) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+            sum += radiosity[(t - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex] *
+                   radiosity[t * numTriangles + i];
+        }
+        if (sum > maximumCorrelation) {
+            maximumCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTimestep = lag;
+        }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON) atomicAdd(nonzero, 1ULL);
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergyKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t numTriangles,
+                                  size_t numTimesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                                  size_t localCount, unsigned long long* received) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(received, 1ULL);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-free representation used by CUDA kernels.  Leaf triangle references
+// retain the exact ordering of the host octree traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    uint32_t triangleOffset;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+    uint32_t subtreeEnd;
+};
+
+int flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                      std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleRefs) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = source.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleRefs.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleRefs.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleRefs);
+        }
+    }
+    nodes[static_cast<size_t>(nodeIndex)].subtreeEnd =
+        static_cast<uint32_t>(nodes.size());
+    return nodeIndex;
+}

+__device__ uint64_t mixBits(uint64_t value) {
+    value += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, int ray, int component) {
+    const uint64_t bits = mixBits(42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL) ^
+                                  (static_cast<uint64_t>(ray) << 16) ^
+                                  static_cast<uint64_t>(component));
+    return static_cast<val_t>((bits >> 40) + 0.5) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDevice(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                             uint64_t pairIndex, int ray,
+                                             int componentOffset) {
+    val_t u = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset);
+    val_t v = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset + 1);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDevice(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersectDevice(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                             const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 pvec = direction.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const val_t invDet = ONE / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = origin - triangle.a;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < ZERO || u > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = direction.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < ZERO || u + v > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool isRayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                    const Triangle* triangles,
+                                    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                    const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                    uint32_t nodeCount, uint32_t srcTriangle,
+                                    uint32_t dstTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 ray = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = ray.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 direction = ray / rayLength;
+
+    // Nodes are stored in depth-first order.  subtreeEnd makes traversal
+    // stackless: a rejected box skips its complete subtree.
+    uint32_t nodeIndex = 0;
+    while (nodeIndex < nodeCount) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!rayIntersectsBoxDevice(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = node.subtreeEnd;
+            continue;
+        }
+        for (uint32_t ref = 0; ref < node.triangleCount; ++ref) {
+            const uint32_t triangleIndex = triangleRefs[node.triangleOffset + ref];
+            if (triangleIndex == srcTriangle || triangleIndex == dstTriangle) continue;
+            const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersectDevice(
+                from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+        }
+        ++nodeIndex;
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                        size_t pairCount) {
+    const size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const val_t distance = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                         uint32_t nodeCount, val_t* kij,
+                                         size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                         size_t pairCount) {
+    constexpr unsigned RAY_GROUP_SIZE = NUM_RAYS;
+    const size_t linearThread = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t pair = linearThread / RAY_GROUP_SIZE;
+    const unsigned ray = static_cast<unsigned>(linearThread % RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    val_t sample = ZERO;
+
+    if (i != j && triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) <= 0.99f) {
+        const uint64_t globalPair = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j;
+        const Vec3 pointI = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleI, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 0);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleJ, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 2);
+        if (!isRayBlockedDevice(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleRefs,
+                                nodeCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                                static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) {
+            const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+            const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared >= EPSILON) {
+                const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+                const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    direction.dot(triangleI.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    (-direction).dot(triangleJ.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                    sample = (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    const unsigned laneInWarp = threadIdx.x & 31U;
+    const unsigned groupBase = laneInWarp & ~15U;
+    const unsigned mask = 0x0000ffffU << groupBase;
+    for (unsigned offset = RAY_GROUP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        sample += __shfl_down_sync(mask, sample, offset, RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    }
+    if (ray == 0) kij[pair] = sample * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                const val_t* areas, val_t* radiosity,
+                                size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const size_t matrixRow = localI * numTriangles;
+
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixRow + j];
+        if (timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay)) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[matrixRow + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const val_t previous = radiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) *
+                                         numTriangles + j];
+        if (previous <= ZERO) continue;
+        sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * previous;
+    }
+
+    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+    radiosity[timestep * numTriangles + i] = reflectivity * sum + emission;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances,
+                                       size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                       size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t maximumCorrelation = ZERO;
+    size_t bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = 0; lag < numTimesteps; ++lag) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+            sum += radiosity[(t - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex] *
+                   radiosity[t * numTriangles + i];
+        }
+        if (sum > maximumCorrelation) {
+            maximumCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTimestep = lag;
+        }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON) atomicAdd(nonzero, 1ULL);
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergyKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t numTriangles,
+                                  size_t numTimesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                                  size_t localCount, unsigned long long* received) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(received, 1ULL);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-free representation used by CUDA kernels.  Leaf triangle references
+// retain the exact ordering of the host octree traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    uint32_t triangleOffset;
+    uint32_t triangleCount;
+    uint32_t subtreeEnd;
+};
+
+int flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                      std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleRefs) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = source.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleRefs.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleRefs.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleRefs);
+        }
+    }
+    nodes[static_cast<size_t>(nodeIndex)].subtreeEnd =
+        static_cast<uint32_t>(nodes.size());
+    return nodeIndex;
+}

+__device__ uint64_t mixBits(uint64_t value) {
+    value += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    return value ^ (value >> 31);
+}
+
+__device__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, int ray, int component) {
+    const uint64_t bits = mixBits(42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL) ^
+                                  (static_cast<uint64_t>(ray) << 16) ^
+                                  static_cast<uint64_t>(component));
+    return static_cast<val_t>((bits >> 40) + 0.5) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDevice(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                             uint64_t pairIndex, int ray,
+                                             int componentOffset) {
+    val_t u = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset);
+    val_t v = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset + 1);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDevice(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
+                                        const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
+    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
+    const Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersectDevice(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
+                                             const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
+    const Vec3 pvec = direction.cross(e2);
+    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const val_t invDet = ONE / det;
+    const Vec3 tvec = origin - triangle.a;
+    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < ZERO || u > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
+    const val_t v = direction.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < ZERO || u + v > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
+    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool isRayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
+                                    const Triangle* triangles,
+                                    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                    const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                    uint32_t nodeCount, uint32_t srcTriangle,
+                                    uint32_t dstTriangle) {
+    const Vec3 ray = to - from;
+    const val_t rayLength = ray.norm();
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const Vec3 direction = ray / rayLength;
+
+    // Nodes are stored in depth-first order.  subtreeEnd makes traversal
+    // stackless: a rejected box skips its complete subtree.
+    uint32_t nodeIndex = 0;
+    while (nodeIndex < nodeCount) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+        if (!rayIntersectsBoxDevice(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = node.subtreeEnd;
+            continue;
+        }
+        for (uint32_t ref = 0; ref < node.triangleCount; ++ref) {
+            const uint32_t triangleIndex = triangleRefs[node.triangleOffset + ref];
+            if (triangleIndex == srcTriangle || triangleIndex == dstTriangle) continue;
+            const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersectDevice(
+                from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+        }
+        ++nodeIndex;
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
+                                        size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                        size_t pairCount) {
+    const size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const val_t distance = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
+                                         const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
+                                         uint32_t nodeCount, val_t* kij,
+                                         size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
+                                         size_t pairCount) {
+    constexpr unsigned RAY_GROUP_SIZE = NUM_RAYS;
+    const size_t linearThread = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t pair = linearThread / RAY_GROUP_SIZE;
+    const unsigned ray = static_cast<unsigned>(linearThread % RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
+
+    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
+    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    val_t sample = ZERO;
+
+    if (i != j && triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) <= 0.99f) {
+        const uint64_t globalPair = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j;
+        const Vec3 pointI = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleI, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 0);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleJ, globalPair,
+                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 2);
+        if (!isRayBlockedDevice(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleRefs,
+                                nodeCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
+                                static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) {
+            const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+            const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+            if (distanceSquared >= EPSILON) {
+                const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+                const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    direction.dot(triangleI.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+                    (-direction).dot(triangleJ.normal()) * inverseDistance);
+                if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+                    sample = (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    const unsigned laneInWarp = threadIdx.x & 31U;
+    const unsigned groupBase = laneInWarp & ~15U;
+    const unsigned mask = 0x0000ffffU << groupBase;
+    for (unsigned offset = RAY_GROUP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        sample += __shfl_down_sync(mask, sample, offset, RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
+    }
+    if (ray == 0) kij[pair] = sample * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                const val_t* areas, val_t* radiosity,
+                                size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex,
+                                val_t reflectivity) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const size_t matrixRow = localI * numTriangles;
+
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[matrixRow + j];
+        if (timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay)) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[matrixRow + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const val_t previous = radiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) *
+                                         numTriangles + j];
+        if (previous <= ZERO) continue;
+        sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * previous;
+    }
+
+    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
+    radiosity[timestep * numTriangles + i] = reflectivity * sum + emission;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances,
+                                       size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
+                                       size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    val_t maximumCorrelation = ZERO;
+    size_t bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = 0; lag < numTimesteps; ++lag) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+            sum += radiosity[(t - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex] *
+                   radiosity[t * numTriangles + i];
+        }
+        if (sum > maximumCorrelation) {
+            maximumCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTimestep = lag;
+        }
+    }
+    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+}
+
+__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
+                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON) atomicAdd(nonzero, 1ULL);
+}
+
+__global__ void countEnergyKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t numTriangles,
+                                  size_t numTimesteps, size_t localBegin,
+                                  size_t localCount, unsigned long long* received) {
+    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (localI >= localCount) return;
+    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
+    for (size_t t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
+        if (radiosity[t * numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {
+            atomicAdd(received, 1ULL);
+            return;
+        }
+    }
+}

   317	    template<typename Func>
   318	    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {
   319	        // If leaf node, check triangles directly
   320	        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {
   321	            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {
   322	                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;
   323	            }
   324	            return false;
   325	        }
   326	
   327	        // Otherwise, descend to children
   328	        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
   329	            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {
   330	                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;
   331	            }
   332	        }
   333	        return false;
   334	    }
   335	};
   336	
   337	// Pointer-free representation used by CUDA kernels.  Leaf triangle references
   338	// retain the exact ordering of the host octree traversal.
   339	struct FlatOctreeNode {
   340	    Vec3 center;
   341	    Vec3 halfExtent;
   342	    uint32_t triangleOffset;
   343	    uint32_t triangleCount;
   344	    uint32_t subtreeEnd;
   345	};
   346	
   347	int flattenOctreeNode(const Octree& source, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
   348	                      std::vector<uint32_t>& triangleRefs) {
   349	    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
   350	    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
   351	    flat.center = source.center;
   352	    flat.halfExtent = source.halfExtent;
   353	    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleRefs.size());
   354	    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(source.triangleIndices.size());
   355	    for (size_t triangleIndex : source.triangleIndices) {
   356	        triangleRefs.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndex));
   357	    }
   358	    nodes.push_back(flat);
   359	
   360	    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
   361	        if (source.children[child]) {
   362	            flattenOctreeNode(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleRefs);
   363	        }
   364	    }
   365	    nodes[static_cast<size_t>(nodeIndex)].subtreeEnd =
   366	        static_cast<uint32_t>(nodes.size());
   367	    return nodeIndex;
   368	}
   369	
   370	// ============================================================================
   371	// Mesh Generation: Icosphere
   372	// ============================================================================
   373	
   374	// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron
   375	class IcosphereMesh {
   376	public:
   377	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   378	
   379	    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {
   380	        // Initial icosahedron vertices
   381	        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;
   382	
   383	        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {
   384	            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
   385	            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
   386	            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
   387	            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
   388	            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,
   389	            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,
   390	            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,
   575	// ============================================================================
   576	// CUDA kernels
   577	// ============================================================================
   578	
   579	__device__ uint64_t mixBits(uint64_t value) {
   580	    value += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   581	    value = (value ^ (value >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   582	    value = (value ^ (value >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
   583	    return value ^ (value >> 31);
   584	}
   585	
   586	__device__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, int ray, int component) {
   587	    const uint64_t bits = mixBits(42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd2b74407b1ce6e93ULL) ^
   588	                                  (static_cast<uint64_t>(ray) << 16) ^
   589	                                  static_cast<uint64_t>(component));
   590	    return static_cast<val_t>((bits >> 40) + 0.5) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
   591	}
   592	
   593	__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangleDevice(const Triangle& triangle,
   594	                                             uint64_t pairIndex, int ray,
   595	                                             int componentOffset) {
   596	    val_t u = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset);
   597	    val_t v = randomUnit(pairIndex, ray, componentOffset + 1);
   598	    if (u + v > ONE) {
   599	        u = ONE - u;
   600	        v = ONE - v;
   601	    }
   602	    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
   603	           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
   604	}
   605	
   606	__device__ bool rayIntersectsBoxDevice(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2,
   607	                                        const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
   608	    const Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
   609	    const Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;
   610	    const Vec3 ad(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
   611	
   612	    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
   613	    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
   614	    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
   615	    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
   616	        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
   617	    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
   618	        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
   619	    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
   620	        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
   621	    return true;
   622	}
   623	
   624	__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersectDevice(const Vec3& origin, const Vec3& direction,
   625	                                             const Triangle& triangle) {
   626	    const Vec3 e1 = triangle.b - triangle.a;
   627	    const Vec3 e2 = triangle.c - triangle.a;
   628	    const Vec3 pvec = direction.cross(e2);
   629	    const val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);
   630	    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
   631	
   632	    const val_t invDet = ONE / det;
   633	    const Vec3 tvec = origin - triangle.a;
   634	    const val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
   635	    if (u < ZERO || u > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
   636	    const Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
   637	    const val_t v = direction.dot(qvec) * invDet;
   638	    if (v < ZERO || u + v > ONE) return FLT_MAX;
   639	    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
   640	}
   641	
   642	__device__ bool isRayBlockedDevice(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
   643	                                    const Triangle* triangles,
   644	                                    const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
   645	                                    const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
   646	                                    uint32_t nodeCount, uint32_t srcTriangle,
   647	                                    uint32_t dstTriangle) {
   648	    const Vec3 ray = to - from;
   649	    const val_t rayLength = ray.norm();
   650	    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
   651	    const Vec3 direction = ray / rayLength;
   652	
   653	    // Nodes are stored in depth-first order.  subtreeEnd makes traversal
   654	    // stackless: a rejected box skips its complete subtree.
   655	    uint32_t nodeIndex = 0;
   656	    while (nodeIndex < nodeCount) {
   657	        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
   658	        if (!rayIntersectsBoxDevice(from, to, node)) {
   659	            nodeIndex = node.subtreeEnd;
   660	            continue;
   661	        }
   662	        for (uint32_t ref = 0; ref < node.triangleCount; ++ref) {
   663	            const uint32_t triangleIndex = triangleRefs[node.triangleOffset + ref];
   664	            if (triangleIndex == srcTriangle || triangleIndex == dstTriangle) continue;
   665	            const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersectDevice(
   666	                from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
   667	            if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
   668	        }
   669	        ++nodeIndex;
   670	    }
   671	    return false;
   672	}
   673	
   674	__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* triangles, int* tau,
   675	                                        size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
   676	                                        size_t pairCount) {
   677	    const size_t pair = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   678	    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
   679	    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
   680	    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
   681	    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
   682	    if (i == j) {
   683	        tau[pair] = 0;
   684	        return;
   685	    }
   686	    const val_t distance = (triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center()).norm();
   687	    tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(distance * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   688	}
   689	
   690	__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* triangles,
   691	                                         const FlatOctreeNode* nodes,
   692	                                         const uint32_t* triangleRefs,
   693	                                         uint32_t nodeCount, val_t* kij,
   694	                                         size_t numTriangles, size_t localBegin,
   695	                                         size_t pairCount) {
   696	    constexpr unsigned RAY_GROUP_SIZE = NUM_RAYS;
   697	    const size_t linearThread = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   698	    const size_t pair = linearThread / RAY_GROUP_SIZE;
   699	    const unsigned ray = static_cast<unsigned>(linearThread % RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
   700	    if (pair >= pairCount) return;
   701	
   702	    const size_t localI = pair / numTriangles;
   703	    const size_t j = pair - localI * numTriangles;
   704	    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
   705	    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
   706	    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
   707	    val_t sample = ZERO;
   708	
   709	    if (i != j && triangleI.normal().dot(triangleJ.normal()) <= 0.99f) {
   710	        const uint64_t globalPair = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * numTriangles + j;
   711	        const Vec3 pointI = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleI, globalPair,
   712	                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 0);
   713	        const Vec3 pointJ = randomPointInTriangleDevice(triangleJ, globalPair,
   714	                                                        static_cast<int>(ray), 2);
   715	        if (!isRayBlockedDevice(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleRefs,
   716	                                nodeCount, static_cast<uint32_t>(i),
   717	                                static_cast<uint32_t>(j))) {
   718	            const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
   719	            const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
   720	            if (distanceSquared >= EPSILON) {
   721	                const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
   722	                const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
   723	                    direction.dot(triangleI.normal()) * inverseDistance);
   724	                const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
   725	                    (-direction).dot(triangleJ.normal()) * inverseDistance);
   726	                if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
   727	                    sample = (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
   728	                }
   729	            }
   730	        }
   731	    }
   732	
   733	    const unsigned laneInWarp = threadIdx.x & 31U;
   734	    const unsigned groupBase = laneInWarp & ~15U;
   735	    const unsigned mask = 0x0000ffffU << groupBase;
   736	    for (unsigned offset = RAY_GROUP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   737	        sample += __shfl_down_sync(mask, sample, offset, RAY_GROUP_SIZE);
   738	    }
   739	    if (ray == 0) kij[pair] = sample * INV_NUM_RAYS;
   740	}
   741	
   742	__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
   743	                                const val_t* areas, val_t* radiosity,
   744	                                size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
   745	                                size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
   746	                                size_t timestep, size_t sourceIndex,
   747	                                val_t reflectivity) {
   748	    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   749	    if (localI >= localCount) return;
   750	    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
   751	    val_t sum = ZERO;
   752	    const size_t matrixRow = localI * numTriangles;
   753	
   754	    for (size_t j = 0; j < numTriangles; ++j) {
   755	        if (i == j) continue;
   756	        const int delay = tau[matrixRow + j];
   757	        if (timestep < static_cast<size_t>(delay)) continue;
   758	        const val_t formFactor = kij[matrixRow + j];
   759	        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
   760	        const val_t previous = radiosity[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) *
   761	                                         numTriangles + j];
   762	        if (previous <= ZERO) continue;
   763	        sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * previous;
   764	    }
   765	
   766	    const val_t emission = (i == sourceIndex && timestep < numTimesteps / 2) ? ONE : ZERO;
   767	    radiosity[timestep * numTriangles + i] = reflectivity * sum + emission;
   768	}
   769	
   770	__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radiosity, val_t* distances,
   771	                                       size_t numTriangles, size_t numTimesteps,
   772	                                       size_t localBegin, size_t localCount,
   773	                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
   774	    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   775	    if (localI >= localCount) return;
   776	    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
   777	    val_t maximumCorrelation = ZERO;
   778	    size_t bestTimestep = 0;
   779	    for (size_t lag = 0; lag < numTimesteps; ++lag) {
   780	        val_t sum = ZERO;
   781	        for (size_t t = lag; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
   782	            sum += radiosity[(t - lag) * numTriangles + sourceIndex] *
   783	                   radiosity[t * numTriangles + i];
   784	        }
   785	        if (sum > maximumCorrelation) {
   786	            maximumCorrelation = sum;
   787	            bestTimestep = lag;
   788	        }
   789	    }
   790	    distances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
   791	}
   792	
   793	__global__ void countFormFactorsKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t count,
   794	                                       unsigned long long* nonzero) {
   795	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   796	    if (index < count && kij[index] > EPSILON) atomicAdd(nonzero, 1ULL);
   797	}
   798	
   799	__global__ void countEnergyKernel(const val_t* radiosity, size_t numTriangles,
   800	                                  size_t numTimesteps, size_t localBegin,
   801	                                  size_t localCount, unsigned long long* received) {
   802	    const size_t localI = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   803	    if (localI >= localCount) return;
   804	    const size_t i = localBegin + localI;
   805	    for (size_t t = 0; t < numTimesteps; ++t) {
   806	        if (radiosity[t * numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {
   807	            atomicAdd(received, 1ULL);
   808	            return;
   809	        }
   810	    }
   811	}
   812	
   813	// ============================================================================
   814	// Room Response Simulation State
   815	// ============================================================================
   816	
   817	struct SimulationState {
   818	    size_t numTriangles;
   819	    size_t numTimesteps;
   820	
   821	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   822	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   823	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source
   824	
   825	    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> flatNodes;
   826	    std::vector<uint32_t> flatTriangleRefs;
   827	
   828	    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure
   829	
   830	    size_t sourceIndex;
   831	    int rank = 0;
   832	    int worldSize = 1;
   833	    int device = 0;
   834	    size_t localBegin = 0;
   835	    size_t localCount = 0;
   836	    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;
   837	
   838	    Triangle* deviceTriangles = nullptr;
   839	    FlatOctreeNode* deviceNodes = nullptr;
   840	    uint32_t* deviceTriangleRefs = nullptr;
   841	    val_t* deviceAreas = nullptr;
   842	    val_t* deviceKij = nullptr;
   843	    int* deviceTau = nullptr;
   844	    val_t* deviceRadB = nullptr;
   845	    val_t* deviceDistances = nullptr;
   850	// ============================================================================
   851	// Initialization
   852	// ============================================================================
   853	
   854	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   855	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   856	    // Generate mesh
   857	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
   858	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   859	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   860	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   861	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   862	    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;
   863	    state.localBegin = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(state.rank) /
   864	                       static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
   865	    const size_t localEnd = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(state.rank + 1) /
   866	                            static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
   867	    state.localCount = localEnd - state.localBegin;
   868	
   869	    if (state.rank == 0)
   870	        printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   871	
   872	    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
   873	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Building octree...\n");
   874	    state.octree.build(state.triangles);
   875	    flattenOctreeNode(state.octree, state.flatNodes, state.flatTriangleRefs);
   876	
   877	    // Initialize areas
   878	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   879	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   880	    for (long long i = 0; i < static_cast<long long>(state.numTriangles); ++i)
   881	        state.areas[static_cast<size_t>(i)] = state.triangles[static_cast<size_t>(i)].area();
   882	
   883	    const size_t pairCount = state.localCount * state.numTriangles;
   884	    const size_t historyCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
   885	    const size_t localAllocation = std::max<size_t>(state.localCount, 1);
   886	    const size_t pairAllocation = std::max<size_t>(pairCount, 1);
   887	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceTriangles,
   888	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle)));
   889	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceNodes,
   890	                          state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));
   891	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceTriangleRefs,
   892	                          state.flatTriangleRefs.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));
   893	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceAreas, state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
   894	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceKij, pairAllocation * sizeof(val_t)));
   895	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceTau, pairAllocation * sizeof(int)));
   896	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceRadB,
   897	                          std::max<size_t>(historyCount, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));
   898	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.deviceDistances, localAllocation * sizeof(val_t)));
   899	
   900	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
   901	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   902	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceNodes, state.flatNodes.data(),
   903	                          state.flatNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode),
   904	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   905	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceTriangleRefs, state.flatTriangleRefs.data(),
   906	                          state.flatTriangleRefs.size() * sizeof(uint32_t),
   907	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   908	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceAreas, state.areas.data(),
   909	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   910	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.deviceKij, 0, pairAllocation * sizeof(val_t)));
   911	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.deviceTau, 0, pairAllocation * sizeof(int)));
   912	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.deviceRadB, 0,
   913	                          std::max<size_t>(historyCount, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));
   914	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&state.hostLocalRow, localAllocation * sizeof(val_t)));
   915	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&state.hostGlobalRow,
   916	                              state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
   917	}
   918	
   919	void releaseSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
   920	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.hostGlobalRow));
   921	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(state.hostLocalRow));
   922	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceDistances));
   923	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceRadB));
   924	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceTau));
   925	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceKij));
   926	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceAreas));
   927	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceTriangleRefs));
   928	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceNodes));
   929	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.deviceTriangles));
   930	}
   931	
   932	// ============================================================================
   933	// Precomputation Phase
   934	// ============================================================================
   935	
   936	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   937	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing form factors (Kij) on CUDA devices...\n");
   938	    const size_t pairCount = state.localCount * state.numTriangles;
   939	    if (pairCount == 0) return;
   940	    constexpr unsigned threads = 256;
   941	    const size_t rayThreads = pairCount * static_cast<size_t>(NUM_RAYS);
   942	    const size_t blocks = (rayThreads + threads - 1) / threads;
   943	    computeFormFactorsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(blocks), threads>>>(
   944	        state.deviceTriangles, state.deviceNodes, state.deviceTriangleRefs,
   945	        static_cast<uint32_t>(state.flatNodes.size()), state.deviceKij,
   946	        state.numTriangles, state.localBegin, pairCount);
   947	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   948	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   949	}
   950	
   951	void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
   952	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing time delays (Tau) on CUDA devices...\n");
   953	    const size_t pairCount = state.localCount * state.numTriangles;
   954	    if (pairCount == 0) return;
   955	    constexpr unsigned threads = 256;
   956	    const size_t blocks = (pairCount + threads - 1) / threads;
   957	    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned>(blocks), threads>>>(
   958	        state.deviceTriangles, state.deviceTau, state.numTriangles,
   959	        state.localBegin, pairCount);
   960	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   961	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   962	}
   963	
   964	// ============================================================================
   965	// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
   966	// ============================================================================
   967	
   968	void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
   969	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Running distributed wave propagation simulation...\n");
   970	    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize));
   971	    std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements(static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize));
   972	    for (int rank = 0; rank < state.worldSize; ++rank) {
   973	        const size_t begin = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(rank) /
   974	                             static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
   975	        const size_t end = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(rank + 1) /
   976	                           static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
   977	        receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(end - begin);
   978	        receiveDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(begin);
   979	    }
   980	
   981	    constexpr unsigned threads = 256;
   982	    const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((state.localCount + threads - 1) / threads);
   983	    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   984	        if (state.localCount != 0) {
   985	            propagateKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
   986	                state.deviceKij, state.deviceTau, state.deviceAreas,
   987	                state.deviceRadB, state.numTriangles, state.numTimesteps,
   988	                state.localBegin, state.localCount, t, state.sourceIndex,
   989	                state.reflectivity);
   990	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   991	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(
   992	                state.hostLocalRow,
   993	                state.deviceRadB + t * state.numTriangles + state.localBegin,
   994	                state.localCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   995	        }
   996	
   997	        MPI_Allgatherv(state.hostLocalRow, static_cast<int>(state.localCount), MPI_FLOAT,
   998	                       state.hostGlobalRow, receiveCounts.data(),
   999	                       receiveDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1000	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.deviceRadB + t * state.numTriangles,
  1001	                              state.hostGlobalRow,
  1002	                              state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
  1003	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
  1004	
  1005	        if (state.rank == 0 && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {
  1006	            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
  1007	        }
  1008	    }
  1009	}
  1010	
  1011	// ============================================================================
  1012	// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
  1013	// ============================================================================
  1014	
  1015	void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
  1016	    if (state.rank == 0) printf("Computing distances via CUDA cross-correlation...\n");
  1017	    constexpr unsigned threads = 256;
  1018	    if (state.localCount != 0) {
  1019	        const unsigned blocks = static_cast<unsigned>((state.localCount + threads - 1) /
  1020	                                                       threads);
  1021	        computeDistancesKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
  1022	            state.deviceRadB, state.deviceDistances, state.numTriangles,
  1023	            state.numTimesteps, state.localBegin, state.localCount,
  1024	            state.sourceIndex);
  1025	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
  1026	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.hostLocalRow, state.deviceDistances,
  1027	                              state.localCount * sizeof(val_t),
  1028	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
  1029	    }
  1030	
  1031	    std::vector<int> receiveCounts;
  1032	    std::vector<int> receiveDisplacements;
  1033	    if (state.rank == 0) {
  1034	        state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles);
  1035	        receiveCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize));
  1036	        receiveDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize));
  1037	        for (int rank = 0; rank < state.worldSize; ++rank) {
  1038	            const size_t begin = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(rank) /
  1039	                                 static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
  1040	            const size_t end = state.numTriangles * static_cast<size_t>(rank + 1) /
  1041	                               static_cast<size_t>(state.worldSize);
  1042	            receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(end - begin);
  1043	            receiveDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(rank)] = static_cast<int>(begin);
  1044	        }
  1045	    }
  1046	    MPI_Gatherv(state.hostLocalRow, static_cast<int>(state.localCount), MPI_FLOAT,
  1047	                state.rank == 0 ? state.distances.data() : nullptr,
  1048	                state.rank == 0 ? receiveCounts.data() : nullptr,
  1049	                state.rank == 0 ? receiveDisplacements.data() : nullptr,
  1050	                MPI_FLOAT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
  1051	}

  1182	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
  1183	    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
  1184	    printf("Options:\n");
  1185	    printf("  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\n");
  1186	    printf("               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\n");
  1187	    printf("               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\n");
  1188	    printf("  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\n");
  1189	    printf("  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\n");
  1190	    printf("  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\n");
  1191	    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
  1192	    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
  1193	    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
  1194	}
